newsitem.title: CANADA: Gibraltar stock up on financing news.
newsitem.headline: Gibraltar stock up on financing news.

text.p: Gibraltar Mines Ltd shares rose Friday on news the company had arranged US$140 million in debt financing for the development of its delayed Lomas Bayas copper project in Chile, analysts said.
Gibralatar shares were up 0.60 at 6.20 in Toronto.
Gibralatar said in July the project would be delayed because it was unable to find underwriters for a US$160 million debt offering amid a sell-off in copper prices.
But it announced Thursday it had obtained a commitment from underwriters for a slightly smaller debt issue and was seeking the rest of the funding it needed.
It said start-up of the processing plant should occur in 1998.

Lomas Bayas is slated to be an open pit mine and processing plant with capacity of 60,000 tonnes of copper cathode a year. Gibraltar previously said the total cash requirement for the project was US$240 million including debt of US$185 million.
